acceptanceCriteria: corvint affected on a change that only adds keys to .corvint/test-read-scopes.json and .corvint/unbounded-readers.json plus one new package selects the new package and the units whose declarations changed, with a test over a fixture change.
body: Observed 2026-10-12 on claude/v1-1275-convert (base b8ef66364, Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456): corvint affected --base b8ef66364 returns PLAN_ONLY with 197 units selected and the full gate mandatory. The change adds one Go package plus one tool and edits .corvint/test-read-scopes.json and .corvint/unbounded-readers.json (a scope declaration for the new package and a new unbounded unit). Those declaration edits appear to widen selection to most of the repository, so the plan gives no usable focused selection for a change whose code impact is bounded. Expected: a declaration edit that only adds a new key selects the declared package (and the units the removed/changed keys covered), not every unit.
title: corvint affected selects 197 units when a change edits .corvint/test-read-scopes.json or unbounded-readers.json
